sources.title: Versioned bounded field-action choices
usedFor: All openly selected numeric, ordering, holder, schema, transactional, and replay rules below

policies.choice: Use the written binary64 expression order, floor and signed truncation points; no additional damage randomness.
Recompute reverse ordinary damage from post-hit troops/status; normal or failed-tactic reaction scale 1; successful melee-tactic scale 1/2, floored after full damage.
Ordinary and reaction critical rates reuse the tactic natural-rate expression.
One primary hit decision; engine-enumerated coverage; primary first then cellId order; independent per-target critical; all active damage uses the action-start snapshot.
At most one response, by the primary target after active damage and status; no collateral or recursive response.
Complete the raw strategy expression and applicable single 倾国 multiplier, then floor and clip 0..100; deterministic endpoints consume no RNG.

One applicable 30% shield gate; 大盾 overrides 矢盾. 矢盾 applies to ordinary damage from weapon=crossbow, including melee ordinary attacks and melee counters; this source-weapon choice is explicit simulation, not a recovered stock caller. Gate precedes critical; blocked active attacks may still receive a legal primary response.
For a supported intelligence-conditional skill, use maximum intelligence among members actually holding that skill; absence is not zero.
Internal O01 status semantic adapter: same-kind max; different-kind rejection; ordinary duration base1/base2 at 70/30 plus critical one; spiral supplies its own duration.
False report writes only abnormal state and remaining count; no movement, home, path, mission, or automatic turn action.
Require the full bounded axial rectangle. Reject a ranged action if any intermediate cell on any shortest axial path is blocked. This is a conservative profile restriction, not stock line-of-sight.
Use separately supplied normal/confused attack and defense panels with all panel-layer technique and status effects already included; no native getter certification.

All technique facts are supplied; each four-level branch includes all prerequisites and same-side units agree. Spear technique 2 necessarily includes technique 1, making the active spear action reject before no-counter behavior can execute.
FNV-1a64 over canonical JSON UTF-16 code units is a non-authenticating content label. Replay safety uses full genesis recomputation and full receipt comparison, not hash equality alone.
矢盾 source classification includes all ordinary damage from weapon=crossbow, including normal melee and melee counterattack. Explicit source-weapon simulation choice, not stock caller recovery.

Record source and target heights and action-start cell; do not add a global attack/defense scalar or tactic-hit height adjustment to supported actions. Fixed 01-map section 6 supports the limited tactic scope while native exactness remains open.
